_README: REI BlackBook selectors, mapped from the Level 10 pilot handoff spec (manual 5-contact run on my.reiblackbook.com). Text/label selectors preferred; icon-only controls are marked NEEDS-DOM and are tolerant guesses (capture exact via `npx playwright codegen`). The engine fails closed: any required element not found -> Needs Review, never a send. Confirmed by spec: REI HAS an Opt-In control (pencil -> Edit Contact modal) and a ProfitDial 'From:' picker (~130 numbers; match by trailing number).

login.submitButton: button[type='submit'], button:has-text('Log In'), button:has-text('Login'), button:has-text('Sign In'), input[type='submit']

contacts.searchInput: input[placeholder*='Search By Name' i], input[placeholder*='Search' i], input[type='search'], input[aria-label*='search' i], .search input
contacts.resultRowLink: table tbody tr td a, .list-row a, [role='row'] a, a[href*='/contacts/']
contacts.noResultsMarker: text=/no result/i, text=/did not match/i, text=/no records/i

editContact._status: Opt-In modal (spec 2.3). Pencil/edit icon near the avatar is NEEDS-DOM; the modal + Update Info button are text-confirmable. Opt-In dropdown is a custom combobox (needs a retry to open); options render as 'Opt - In' / 'Opt - Out'.
editContact.editButton: [aria-label*='edit' i], [title*='edit' i], button:has(svg[class*='pencil' i]), button:has(i[class*='pencil' i]), button:has(i[class*='edit' i]), .contact-header button:has(svg)

chat._status: Chat tab (spec 2.4-2.5). Compose bar has a 'From:' picker (~130 numbers, match by trailing number), TinyMCE reply box (often in an iframe), orange paper-plane Send. Delivery shows async: plain = sent, red 'Undelivered' = failed.
chat.editorFrame: iframe.tox-edit-area__iframe, iframe[id*='tiny' i], iframe[title*='Rich Text' i]
chat.messageInput: body#tinymce[contenteditable='true'], .mce-content-body[contenteditable='true'], [data-mce-placeholder*='Write Your Reply' i], [aria-placeholder*='Write Your Reply' i], textarea[placeholder*='Write Your Reply' i], [contenteditable='true'], div[role='textbox']
chat.sendButton: [aria-label='Send Text' i], [title='Send Text' i], button:has-text('Send Text'), [data-testid*='send' i], [aria-label*='send' i], button[title*='send' i], button:has(svg[class*='send' i]), button:has(svg[class*='paper' i])
